shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
I like to cook new recipes on weekends.
Traveling helps me learn about different cultures.
I often listen to music while studying or working.
Hiking in the mountains is one of my favorite activities.
I usually start my day with a cup of coffee and news.
Attending live concerts is an exciting experience for me.
I believe that volunteering can greatly benefit the community.
Learning a new language opens up many opportunities in life.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable trip you have taken?
Q2: What challenges did you face during that trip?
Q3: How do you feel travel impacts your perspective on life?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What type of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you ever struggled to maintain a regular workout routine?
Q3: In your opinion, why is exercise important for health?
Q4: What tips would you give someone looking to start exercising?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about music preferences.
questions: Q1: What kind of music do you like listening to and why?
Q2: Have you ever been to a concert of your favorite artist?
Q3: How do you think music influences people's emotions?
Q4: What recommendations would you give for discovering new music?
